# supports notability

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:supportsNotability`](gmeow-supportsNotability.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/supportsNotability>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/evidence`](../../slices/evidence.md)

Whether this citation is asserted to support notability (encyclopedic significance) as distinct from factual verification. A citation may verify a fact (high evidential warrant) without supporting notability (e.g. a primary legal filing or a routine listing). Non-functional: competing notability assessments from different standpoints coexist ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:CitationAct`](../classes/gmeow-CitationAct.md) -> [`xsd:boolean`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#boolean)

Use [`gmeow:supportsNotability`](gmeow-supportsNotability.md) from [`gmeow:CitationAct`](../classes/gmeow-CitationAct.md) to [`xsd:boolean`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#boolean) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
